page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin: two notes ("a. Poten-tia," and "3. Pate-factio"). Faint show-through text in the left margin is not transcribed. No right margin text. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: chi filio deductus, sed suspectæ fidei. Sub Justiniano I. Imperatore Rex Æthiopum Axumitatum[?] Adad sive David commemoratus, quod fidem Christianam recepit. Post ipsum incognita & inaccessa nobis mane-bat Abyssinia, & non nisi fabulis pe-regrinantium jactabatur. Circa A.{a} C. 1200 quidam Æthiopum Christianorum potentissimus Imperator, Papa vel Presbyter Johannes, (ex Persica voce Prester Chan i. e. Rex mancipiorum: nam mancipia Abyssena[?] toto Oriente frequentissima sunt) memorabatur, cujus regno incomparabilem felicitatem, qualem Poëtæ hortis Hesperidum, adscribebant.Poten-tia,
main_text.head: Periodus II,
Explicatio.
main_text.p: Circa A. C. 1500 Lusitani ex In-dia3. Pate-factio.

page.notes: The first line of the page continues the paragraph from the previous page. "Axumitatum" is set in italic and I am not fully certain of the letters. "Abyssena" is read from a small, slightly blurred print. The reading of the year "1500" is slightly uncertain. The reference mark "a" in the text is read after "A." in "Circa A." and is inferred from the margin note.
